rappel_detail.station: The ridge top between Lover's Lane and the Zipper couloir, reached on the way up.
rappel_detail.notes: Made on the ascent, not the descent: a rappel of 100+ ft into the adjacent Zipper couloir. Two ropes recommended; a 70 m rope allows some downclimbing on moderate snow first.

rappel_detail.anchor: a large tree a few feet below the summit
rappel_detail.station: Just below the summit, on the descent.
rappel_detail.notes: Rappel from the tree unless the snow is good enough to downclimb, then plunge-step toward the Lane-Denman saddle and descend the steep gully on its far left side.

set.rappel_count_note: Two rappels in all: one of 100+ ft into the Zipper couloir on the way up, and one from a tree just below the summit on the way down, which good snow lets parties skip.
